subject: general
question: The sides of a triangle are 109 cm, 171 cm, and 100 cm. What is the length (in cm) of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 171 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (109 + 171 + 100) ÷ 2 = 190 cm

Area = √[190 × (190 − 109) × (190 − 171) × (190 − 100)]

Area = √[190 × 81 × 19 × 90] = 5130 cm²

Altitude (h) = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 5130) ÷ 171 = 60 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides **a = 109 cm**, **b = 171 cm**, **c = 100 cm**.

**Formula Used:** Heron's Formula Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)] and Area = (1/2) × base × height.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/471a5cda393df75445a5a81a746c2affd7d139a0a5a7773c409d3dbfe40199d5.png] 

⇒ Semi-perimeter s = (109 + 171 + 100) / 2 = 380 / 2 = 190 cm

⇒ Area = √[190 × (190 − 109) × (190 − 171) × (190 − 100)]

⇒ Area = √[190 × 81 × 19 × 90] = √[19 × 10 × 9² × 19 × 9 × 10]

⇒ Area = 19 × 9 × 10 × 3 = 5130 cm²

⇒ 5130 = (1/2) × 171 × h

⇒ h = (5130 × 2) / 171 = 10260 / 171 = 60 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of a triangle when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where s is the semi-perimeter.

Altitude of a Triangle

The perpendicular segment from a vertex to the opposite side. Height h = (2 × Area) ÷ base.

Incircle Radius (Inradius)

The radius of the circle inscribed inside a triangle is given by r = Area ÷ s.</p
